name: Emerald Tablet
notes: No build needed: the published app contains no game data and the player adds their own files in the app. Listed while the Public Repo Audit Tracker row allows its existing public release.

steps: Download the Emerald Tablet IPA from https://github.com/chrissotraidis/emeraldtablet/releases and check it against the SHA-256 file beside it.
Install it with AltStore Classic, SideStore or Sideloadly, signed with your own Apple ID.
Open Emerald Tablet. At Game Data Required, choose your own Pharaoh + Cleopatra installation folder and keep the app open while it copies.
